Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.displayserver.nativewindow.x11

Class FramePacer

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.displayserver.nativewindow.x11.FramePacer
public final class FramePacer extends Object
Throttles how often a composited window's accumulated damage is read back and presented, so unchanged regions are not re-read and re-uploaded more often than the target frame interval (Phase E: frame pacing).

Pure and clock-injected: every method takes the current time in milliseconds rather than reading a clock itself, so the pacing decision is deterministic and unit-testable headlessly. A minIntervalMillis of zero means "always due" — the behaviour CompositedWindowPipeline uses by default, presenting each damage report synchronously.
